pages.title: Tumour Specimen
pages.text: A sample of cells that have forgotten how to stop dividing. Found in tumour nodules in Inner Space's Tumour, and dropped by the Tumour Hydra; an Immortal Cell Line grows more in the Bioreactor.

Made in $(item)Bioreactor$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Tumour Nodule$(), in veins through the rock.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Tumour Hydra.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inner Space.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): CAR-T Cell Culture, Metastasis Ward, Tumour Mass, Tumour Nodule.
